title: [Audit] Security configuration changes
description: Every security configuration change, newest first: API keys created, changed or invalidated, user profile writes, role and privilege edits, with the raw change record. Kibana’s routine API-key clean-up is left out. Elasticsearch records no client IP here.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL AND NOT (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL) | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, event.action, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…") | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, event.action AS Action, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change AS Change
